fieldNotes.truckGate: Single shared entrance driveway off the E Airport Fwy south frontage road (~32.8375,-96.9281). Street View (Oct 2025) and z21 satellite show an open paved drive with guardrails and no barrier arm, sliding gate, or booth at the public-road boundary. No controlled checkpoint visible, so truckGate=false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the street entrance; the gabled structures at the top of the drive are employee-parking car canopies, not a guard shack. Possible unverified security at the building face deep inside; left as false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large internal paved aprons between the office area and the warehouse docks provide ample inside-the-property holding before docks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large drop yard: dense trailer rows north of the main warehouse and a second block east of it, plus trailers between the warehouse and the NE building. 200+ trailers visible; capacity ~300.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors on the south and east faces of the main warehouse plus the NE building; 50+ across the complex (estimated ~70).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on different building faces (south wall office/dock plus east-wall dock apron and the separate NE building).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and large internal paved areas leave room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main production/warehouse building, south office building, and a separate NE warehouse, all on one property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified in imagery; left false and flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; a rail line/ROW lies west of the treeline but does not enter the site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Irving/DFW-metro industrial fabric fronting E Airport Freeway (TX-183).
